c74object.name: tap.airport~
c74object.digest: The Music for Airports incommensurate loop bank
c74object.description: The tap.airport~ object recreates the tape system behind "2/1" on Brian Eno's Music for Airports: up to eight free-running tape loops of unequal, incommensurate lengths, each with a single head that both plays and records. No setter ever resets a phase — the free-run is the piece. The record message punches the input onto a loop at wherever its head happens to be (replacing, no overdub) and freezes it bit-exactly on release; per-loop levels, equal-power pans, and a playback darken corner place the phrases in the stereo field. The period message reports the composite period — the least common multiple of the active lengths — which with well-chosen lengths exceeds a lifetime.

objarg.name: maxloop
objarg.description: Worst-case loop length in seconds (default 30). All eight reels are bought at DSP start — about 92 MB of tape at 48 kHz at the default; size it to the piece.

inlet.digest: Audio input — punched onto any recording loop.

method.name: signal
method.description: Audio to be punched onto any loop whose record gate is open.

method.name: record
method.description: Punch the input onto that loop's tape at wherever its head happens to be (1), or freeze the tape bit-exactly (0). Recording replaces — no overdub; there is no quantized punch-in, and the phase is never reset.

method.name: period
method.description: Report the composite period — the lcm of the active loop lengths, in seconds — out the right outlet. inf means it left the 64-bit range: the piece will not repeat.

method.name: phase
method.description: Report that loop's head position as a fraction of its length (0..1) out the right outlet.

method.name: clear
method.description: Erase every tape and rewind every head — a full restart of the piece. Parameters are kept.

attribute.name: maxloop
attribute.description: Worst-case loop length in seconds (set by the first object argument). Changing it erases every loop when the DSP chain restarts.

attribute.name: loops
attribute.description: Number of active loops (1..8). Newly activated loops come in at their stored settings, their heads wherever they last were.

attribute.name: lengths
attribute.description: Per-loop length in seconds (0.5 up to maxloop). The lengths are the score: keep them incommensurate and the coincidences never repeat. A change is a splice — the head re-wraps and never rewinds. It can click; splices do.

attribute.name: levels
attribute.description: Per-loop linear playback level, slewed. Unclamped (negative flips polarity, like a mixer).

attribute.name: pans
attribute.description: Per-loop equal-power pan, -1 (hard left) to 1 (hard right), slewed. Endpoints are exact: a hard-panned loop is bitwise absent from the far bus.

attribute.name: darken
attribute.description: Per-loop playback darkening corner in Hz. A static tone, not generation loss (a frozen loop replays the same imprint); at 20000 (the default) the stage is bypassed and playback is bit-transparent.

attribute.name: smooth
attribute.description: Anti-zipper ramp time for level, pan, and darken moves, in milliseconds (0 = instant).
